About Us

A respectful place to live

Zelpis Residential focuses on providing a respectful shared living environment where residents can feel comfortable and connected. We believe that a clear, straightforward housing experience starts with helpful communication and shared expectations.

Who We Serve

Adults seeking affordable shared housing

We welcome inquiries from adults exploring shared housing and from families, case managers, social workers, and community organizations helping people find housing options. Contact us to ask about current availability, house expectations, and whether our housing may be a fit.

What to Expect

Shared living, kept simple

  • Shared living arrangements
  • A home with shared spaces
  • Basic house expectations designed to support a respectful living environment
  • An opportunity to discuss availability and next steps

How to Get Started

Three simple steps

  1. 1

    Call or email us

    Reach out by phone or email to start the conversation.

  2. 2

    Ask your questions

    Ask about availability, costs, location, and house expectations.

  3. 3

    Discuss next steps

    Discuss next steps and any screening or agreement required before moving in.

Referral Partners

Helping someone find housing?

Are you a case manager, social worker, discharge planner, or community organization helping someone explore housing? Reach out to learn about our shared living option and whether it may be appropriate for the person you are assisting.
